title: Major Shonen Jump Manga Announces Extended Hiatus At The Last Minute
content: Unlike the famous Weekly Shonen Jump manga by Shueisha, the Jump SQ. magazine from the same publisher isn’t even a decade old. However, it has introduced readers to some of the most incredible manga of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Sakura Wars Game Franchise Gets 3rd Stage Play Adaptation
content: Sega 's Shin Sakura Taisen game is getting a new stage play adaptation titled Shin Sakura Taisen the Stage: Seiden Tsurugi (New Sakura Wars the Stage: Tale of Truth Tsurugi), which will run at Theater Sun Mall in Tokyo from September 18 - 27. Yūri Ōta stars as Asagi Tо̄dо̄. Haruki Iwata plays Shirahime Okita.
author: ANN

title: 5 Shonen Anime Protagonists You’d Never Want to Meet in Real Life
content: Anime protagonists, especially those from the shonen genre, often possess heroic qualities that are genuinely inspiring. It would not be an overstatement to say that they feel like real heroes, people we would want to admire, idolize, and look up to.
author: ComicBook

title: The Apothecary Diaries Creator Debunks Major Fan Theory (& Reveals Maomao’s Surprise Origin)
content: The Apothecary Diaries has had a major fan theory debunked by the original creator behind it all, and it even included a surprising reveal about the original idea behind Maomao’s character too.
author: ComicBook

title: Cancelled Reboot Pitch for Disney’s Best ’90s Animated Series Revealed
content: Disney had a l egendary run of animated shows back in the 1990s , and the best one out of the slate almost got a reboot as revealed through designs for a cancelled pitch that didn’t make it too far.
author: ComicBook

title: 10 Years Later, Cancelled MAPPA Anime Returns With an Official New Release
content: Studio MAPPA’s beloved original anime, Yuri!!! on Ice keeps growing in popularity, even almost 10 years after its premiere. It was the breakthrough anime of the studio, pushing it to a global audience and helping it gain a strong foothold in the industry.
author: ComicBook

title: Korean Occult Film Exhuma Inspires Maengjong Spinoff Webtoon
content: Naver WEBTOON launched a new horror-occult webtoon titled Maengjong on May 30. Maengjong is a spin-off of the hit Korean occult film Exhuma , which drew over 10 million moviegoers and sparked a resurgence of interest in the genre.
author: ANN

title: Konosuba Studio to Share Exciting New Update Ahead of Season 4
content: The studios behind Konosuba: God’s Blessing on this Wonderful World! and Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- have revealed that they will be sharing an exciting new update later this Summer.
author: ComicBook

title: Like a Dragon/Yakuza Stage Play Reveals Main Cast, August Debut
content: The staff for the Like a Dragon / Yakuza game's planned stage play announced on Tuesday the play will run in Tokyo from August 21-30 under the title Butai Ryu ga Gotoku: Kamurochō Hakkenden (Like a Dragon Stage: Kamurochō Hakkenden).
author: ANN

title: 4 Years Later, Major Crunchyroll Isekai Shares New Look at Sequel Return
content: A major Isekai anime now streaming with Crunchyroll is coming back for a new season after four long years, and has dropped a new look at its big makeover ahead of its premiere later this year.
author: ComicBook
